utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it low-key. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — just bring whatever tools you’ve got and keep it quiet. I’ll repeat the plan to everyone else once we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks are bringing in all sorts of things. If you need the details, I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that sounds good—yeah, if you’ve got the details, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the repair drive starting, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it starts around 10, and if you’ve got gloves or a screwdriver, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, sorry I’m late — I heard there’s a repair drive? I can help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — glad you’re here. We’re sorting tools and sign-ups near the community shed if you want to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Kira — if you need tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow. Just let me know what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Gus — just to confirm, are you saying I can borrow the tools today?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of what we still need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—my head’s a bit all over the place today. I know we’ve gathered some tools and a few paint cans, but I’d better let you check the list so I don’t muddle it up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara — could you help coordinate donations and keep an eye on pickup/drop-off times?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a repair drive was happening soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve only heard it’s still on for this week. I can check the flyer and tell you the time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Just let me know the exact spot and I’ll plan my route around it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the supplies and check who’s bringing what? I’m trying to make sure we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the repair drive details before I do anything. What’s the first item you want me to look at?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — could you start with the sign-up sheet and make sure the pickup time is clear?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or swing by and give you the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, swing by and tell me the details. I’d like to hear more before I decide.
